summary.headline: PDS FY26 revenue rose 4% to ₹13,110 crores, Q4 PAT nearly doubled QoQ to ₹72 crores, and the order book is up ~11% to ₹5,074 crores.
summary.overview: PDS delivered FY26 GMV of about ₹19,666 crores (+5%) and revenue of ₹13,110 crores (+4%), with full-year PAT down to ₹178 crores from ₹241 crores. Q4 PAT rose about 95% QoQ to ₹72 crores on better operating leverage, cost control and lower finance costs. Net debt fell to about ₹105 crores from ₹374 crores despite the Knit Gallery acquisition. Management guided to mid-single-digit revenue growth and ~10% profit growth for FY27, with gross margin up 40-50 bps a year and opex growth below top-line growth; analysts pressed on the gap between order-book growth and the guidance.

segments.name: Sourcing
segments.commentary: Revenue ~₹12,399 crores with EBIT of ₹266 crores in FY26, described as resilient.

segments.name: Manufacturing
segments.commentary: Revenue grew 31% YoY to ~₹1,034 crores; EBIT rose to ₹57 crores (~5.5% margin), helped by factory utilisation and Knit Gallery integration.

segments.name: New Lobster (brands)
segments.commentary: Income from operations ~₹500 crores (vs ~₹480 crores), gross margin fell from ~30% to ~20% as the Ted Baker agency business dried up; PAT rose to ~₹38 crores from ~₹13 crores.

segments.name: Americas
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue flat YoY in USD (~+0.4%) and down ~4-5% QoQ; order book up ~30% YoY. Management said the US business was PBT positive in Q4.

segments.name: UK and Europe
segments.commentary: Order book growth low single digit (~3-4%).

guidance_outlook: FY27 mid-single-digit revenue growth (~5-6%) and ~10% profit growth, with a cautious stance.
Gross margin to improve 40-50 bps a year over the next 1-2 years; EBITDA margin to improve 50-75 bps in FY27.
Employee and other expenses to grow more slowly than the top line in FY27; employee cost base ~₹1,310 crores.
New vertical investment to fall to ~₹80 crores in FY27, then ₹50-60 crores a year; no new verticals for the next 12 months.
Medium to long-term mid-teens growth targeted; management said the 5% PAT target is still behind.
Top-10 clients expected to grow ~7-8% in FY27; new verticals and North America to drive growth.
Net working capital to be held near current levels (~4 days).
capex_capacity: Capex in FY26 was reduced by more than half versus FY25.
Manufacturing footprint in Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and India (Knit Gallery acquired).
Design-led sourcing draws on ~600 approved factories across Asia.
Project PULSE: AI-enabled digital backbone integrating sourcing, supplier governance, procurement, pricing and master data, building on BCG-led cost programme.
Restructuring: closed Design ARC branch and Lilly & Sid; consolidated Design ARC Asia and licensing into Poeticgem; exited Grupo and J-Craft.
demand_pricing: Order book as of early April 2026 ~₹5,074 crores, up ~11% YoY; North America up ~30%.
Secured a new sourcing-as-a-service mandate with a leading US value retailer, scalable beyond ~₹475 crores over time.
Customers remain cautious with shorter order cycles and selective deferments; no broad-based cancellations.
Management said some customers pushed back on shipments and held inventory in the past year.
Pipeline: large sourcing-as-a-service contracts (4-5 year terms) expected to be signed within 2-3 months; the company and Li & Fung are in RFQ stage for global sourcing contracts.

qa_highlights.question: What are the gross margin and EBITDA margin outlook for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Gross margin to rise 40-50 bps average per year over 1-2 years; EBITDA margin to rise 50-75 bps this year, aided by lower one-off restructuring costs.

qa_highlights.question: Is the ~16-17 day working capital sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it will not go back to 17 days and aims to hold current levels for the year, with quarterly fluctuations possible.

qa_highlights.question: Why did Poeticgem and Simple Approach margins erode?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed it to one-time redundancy costs from the BCG-led efficiency programme in H2; both verticals are expected to return to profit growth.

qa_highlights.question: Why does the order book growth (11%) not translate into higher revenue growth (5-6%)?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited customer caution on inventory and shipment pushbacks; UK and Europe order book is only ~3-4%, Asia ~8-9%, Americas ~30%.

qa_highlights.question: How does PDS keep winning share with retailers like Walmart?
qa_highlights.answer: Pallak Seth said 70-80% of retailer sourcing goes through third-party vendors and that PDS offers four services: manufacturing, strategic vendor (design-led sourcing), sourcing-as-a-service, and brands.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook for the Ted Baker (New Lobster) business?
qa_highlights.answer: Management is negotiating with ABG for ~$2-2.5 million a year in financial support for 12 months, with a request to extend it for 24 more months; a conclusion is expected in 4-6 weeks.

risks_watch: Ted Baker franchise partner insolvencies; New Lobster support from ABG is only for 12 months (~$2-2.5 million).
Order book growth of 11% vs guided 5-6% revenue growth; Europe weakness after Matalan and Gerry Weber exits.
Brand business (wholesale) under review; further portfolio rationalisation and one-time costs possible.
Management did not reconcile the BCG-driven ~₹90-100 crore EBITDA uplift with only ~10% profit growth; analysts questioned this.
Other expenses rose ~16% (≈11% ex acquisitions), including royalty payments on curtailed brands and shutdown provisions.
Low Q4 effective tax rate (~7.9%) from DTA recognition; sustainability of the tax rate.
Concentration in top-10 clients (two faced challenges in FY26); top-10 growth guided at ~7-8%.
summary.management_tone: Cautious but constructive: management repeatedly stressed "extreme caution" for FY27 and guided conservatively, while highlighting order-book growth, cost discipline and profit recovery. It was evasive on the US Q4 profit variance and on multi-year numeric targets, deferring follow-ups offline.

the growth in expenses should be slower than growth in the top line.
we are surely not going to allow it to go back to 17 days.

growth.why: FY27 guided to mid-single-digit (~5-6%) revenue growth and ~10% profit growth, backed by an order book of ~₹5,074 crores (+~11% YoY) and gross margin gains of 40-50 bps a year, though the brief gives no new capacity and analysts questioned the gap between order-book growth and guidance.
